To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the current crowding and initial concentration gradient of the lead atoms in mixed SnPb SAC solder joints are two new factors for the redistribution of lead-rich phases.
the electromigration damage in SAC305 solder joints of BGA package with eutectics solder paste is related to the initial concentration gradient and current crowding effect.
the electromigration failure of SnPb/SAC305 mixed solder joint was caused by the current crowding at the upper-right of the solder joint and the redistribution of Pb atoms in the solder bump.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the electromigration damage of SAC305 lead-free solder joints in mixed solder joints, which will be helpful to understand the electromigration failure mechanism of SAC305 solder joints and provide a reference for lead-free electronic packaging.
the effect of current density distribution and polarity of current flow on the microstructure evolution of mixed solder bump under electromigration test.
the electromigration failure of SnPb/SAC305 lead-free mixed solder joints.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the electromigration failure of mixed solder joints is due to the current crowding at the corner of the solder joints, which is caused by the non-uniform current density distribution in solder joints and the Pb atoms redistribution.

the electromigration damage mechanism of SAC305 lead-free mixed solder bump was different from that of SnPb solder bump, and the electromigration behavior of SAC305 lead free solder bump was also affected by the initial concentration gradient and current density distribution.

the current crowding and current density distribution are the two key factors to the electromigration failure of Sn3.0Ag0.5Cu lead-free Bump Grid Array (BGB) packages assembled with SnPd solder paste.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the electromigration failure of the mixed solder bump was due to the current crowding and the electromigration of Pb atoms.
the electromigration effect on SnPb/SnAgCu mixed solder joints was similar to that on the single solder joints.
the Pb atoms migration and the IMC growth were enhanced by the electric current, which was the main reason for the electromigration failure of SnPb/SAC305 mixed solder joints.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the electromigration failure in the lead-free mixed solder joint was different from that in the pure SnPb solder joint.

the current density and current crowding effect should be considered in the electromigration failure of the mixed solder joints, and the electromigration damage mechanism of the mixed solder joint was different from the SnAgCu leadfree solder joint.
electromigration failure of SnPb/SAC305 mixed solder bump can be induced by the redistribution of Pb atoms, and current crowding effect.
